// Icon theme configuration

  home: Home,
  dashboard: Home,
  courses: BookOpen,

  // Achievements & Progress
  target: Target,

  flame: Flame,

  star: Star,

  chevronRight: ChevronRight,
  chevronLeft: ChevronLeft,
  
  // Charts & Analytics
  barChart: BarChart3,
  pieChart: PieChart,
  trendingUp: TrendingUp,
  trendingDown: TrendingDown,
  activity: Activity,
  
  // Media & Controls
  volume: Volume2,
  volumeMute: VolumeX,
  maximize: Maximize,
  minimize: Minimize,
  zoomIn: ZoomIn,
  zoomOut: ZoomOut,
  
  // Layout & Display
  grid: Grid,
  list: List,
  clock: Clock,
  calendarDays: CalendarDays,
  
  // Utilities
  externalLink: ExternalLink,
  share: Share2,
  zap: Zap,
  shield: Shield,
  key: Key,
  
  // Additional icons for course creation
  settings: Settings,
  tag: Tag,
  edit: Edit,
  hash: Hash,
  fileText: FileText,

  folder: Folder,
  trendingUp: TrendingUp,
  clock: Clock,
  globe: Globe,
  target: Target,
  checkCircle: CheckCircle,
  star: Star,
  search: Search,
  archive: Archive,
  circle: Circle,
  refresh: RefreshCw,
  plus: Plus,
  trash: Trash2,
  loader: RefreshCw
};

// Icon component with consistent styling
export const Icon = ({ 
  name, 
  size = 20, 
  color = 'currentColor', 
  className = '',
  style = {},
  ...props 
}) => {
  const IconComponent = IconTheme[name];
  
  if (!IconComponent) {
    console.warn(`Icon "${name}" not found in IconTheme`);
    return null;
  }
  
  return (
    <IconComponent
      size={size}
      color={color}
      className={className}
      style={{
        flexShrink: 0,
        ...style
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
};

// Common icon sizes
export const IconSizes = {
  xs: 16,
  sm: 20,
  md: 24,
  lg: 32,
  xl: 48,
  xxl: 64
};

// Common icon colors based on your theme
export const IconColors = {
  primary: 'var(--primary-blue)',
  secondary: 'var(--secondary-blue)',
  success: 'var(--success)',
  warning: 'var(--warning)',
  danger: 'var(--danger)',
  info: 'var(--info)',
  white: '#FFFFFF',
  gray: 'var(--gray-500)',
  dark: 'var(--gray-800)',
  light: 'var(--gray-300)'
};

export default Icon;
